Container.Name: ltx-2-trainer
Container.Overview: LTX-2 trainer (torch 2.11 / CUDA 13, Blackwell-ready). Starts as a keep-alive container: open the container Console (>_) and run scripts/process_dataset.py then scripts/train.py. Requires the Unraid "Nvidia Driver" plugin. Mount your LTX-2 checkpoint + Gemma encoder at /models (read-only) and a working folder at /workspace (read-write).
Container.Requires: Unraid "Nvidia Driver" plugin (ich777) must be installed.

Config.Name: Models (checkpoint + Gemma)
Config.Description: Folder holding the LTX-2 .safetensors checkpoint and the Gemma text-encoder directory. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Workspace (data / configs / output)
Config.Description: Datasets, preprocessed latents, YAML configs, and output checkpoints / logs / validation samples.

Config.Name: GPU (NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
Config.Description: GPU to expose. Use 'all', or a specific UUID from 'nvidia-smi -L' on the Unraid terminal to pin one GPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver capabilities exposed to the container.

Config.Name: WANDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Weights & Biases API key. Leave blank to disable W&B (or set WANDB_MODE=offline).

Config.Name: HF_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional Hugging Face token, only needed if pushing the trained LoRA to the Hub (hub.push_to_hub: true).
